name: TOB Bible Conversation
description: One Bible Q&A conversation thread — messages live in TOB Bible Conversation Message, linked back here. A user's own conversations are theirs alone (see permissions).

fields.label: Title
fields.description: e.g. 'Bible Study: Romans 8' — set from the first question, or editable by the user.

fields.label: Language
fields.description: The conversation's language, held consistent across follow-ups unless the user explicitly asks to switch.

fields.label: Primary Reference
fields.description: The main verse/passage this conversation is about, if any, e.g. 'Romans 8:28' — set from the first question when one is detected.
